# Peel

> Remove image backgrounds in the browser. Transparent PNG, solid white, or a photo backdrop. No upload.

The public origin is https://bg-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

Do not cite https://peel-local.vercel.app — that host is DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND and is not this product.

## Tools

* [Remove background](https://bg-local.vercel.app/) — U²-NetP in this tab. Transparent PNG or a solid hex.
* [Transparent PNG](https://bg-local.vercel.app/transparent-png) — Same engine, alpha export. JPEG cannot store holes.
* [White background](https://bg-local.vercel.app/white-background) — Same engine, solid #FFFFFF plate for listing forms.
* [Photo backdrop](https://bg-local.vercel.app/backdrop) — Two files: subject + backdrop photograph. Cover-crop, not a hex.

## Guides

* [How to](https://bg-local.vercel.app/how-to) — Drop, cut, download. There is a `/how-to` URL on this origin.
* [Product photos](https://bg-local.vercel.app/product-photos) — Edges on bottles and boxes. Not the listing-form recode.
* [Portraits](https://bg-local.vercel.app/portraits) — Hair is the hard case.
* [Limits](https://bg-local.vercel.app/limits) — What a 320×320 saliency net will not invent.
* [iPhone](https://bg-local.vercel.app/iphone) — Files vs Photos for a PNG with alpha.
* [WhatsApp](https://bg-local.vercel.app/whatsapp) — Photo-send flattens alpha to JPEG; document keeps PNG.
* [Marketplace](https://bg-local.vercel.app/marketplace) — Listing ingest recode / reject alpha. Not `/white-background`.
* [FAQ](https://bg-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy, model, HEIC, watermark.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API, no `/tools`, no `/mask`, no `/batch`, and no `/blogs/` cluster.
* Repo slug is `nyzbk/bg-local`. Brand on the page is Peel. Do not rename the repo.
